title: Intersection Point in Y Shaped Lists
description:
[Source: GFG Classic]
Given two singly linked lists of size N and M, write a program to get the point where two linked lists merge. If not merged return -1.

Input Format:
First line: commonVal (or -1)
Second line: list1 values
Third line: list2 values

Output Format:
Intersection node data or -1
